name: client-developer-runbook
description: Developer Runbooks in the GnollHack client repository: where manual tests and every other post-implementation step go, and how to find what is still open. Covers the step kinds and Where values used here, device test sessions on the Steam Deck, WinUI 3, desktop Linux, Android and iOS, wizard-mode checks, combining open tests into one device session, upstream reports waiting on a test, Sentry issues to watch after a release, and recording results. Read when a GnollHack change needs a manual test or anything else from a person, before reporting such work as finished, when the user asks which tests are pending or what to test on a device, and when the user reports a test result.
